experiment: answer re-prefilled into K/V and swapped into the blank masked block
mechanism: main sequence (prefix + blank slots + questions) is forwarded first; its K/V goes into the cache
the sub-agent produces its answer in its own private context
the answer tokens are prefilled against the main's cache truncated to [0, P_k), producing K/V at [P_k, P_k+len)
that K/V replaces the blank block; the suffix is NOT recomputed

arms.swap: answer re-prefilled into K/V and placed in the blank block
arms.inline: answer placed inline in the prompt, whole sequence recomputed

conclusion: re-prefilling the answer into the block is equivalent to having had it inline from the start; the one swap miss was a question-format artifact, not a mechanism failure
